C0397.title: Xuzhou Police in Jiangsu Dismantle Massive QQ Account-Farming Black-Market Platform
C0397.summary: In October 2020, the Xuzhou Public Security Bureau in Jiangsu Province dismantled a massive black-market QQ account-farming platform and successively arrested 84 suspects. The platform helped cybercrime groups bypass QQ account verification procedures, mass-manage and use non-real-name QQ accounts, and provided account resources and technical convenience for online fraud, cross-border gambling, and other illegal activities.
